Functional Requirements Summary: FR-1: One TypeScript/Effect on-chain collector in polymarket-collector serves Dota and LoL; no second Python downloader
FR-2: Fifth Compose service `onchain` mounts both game archives plus a dedicated on-chain state dir and does not use POLYMARKET_TAG_ID
FR-3: Completed UTC days are published as `parquet/onchain_fills/asset_id=<token>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.parquet` with the existing 26-column ONCHAIN_SCHEMA; the current UTC day is never published as ready
FR-4: Catalog comes from both games' `metadata/markets/*.json`; IDs stay strings; outcome index comes from sidecar metadata
FR-5: Two Alchemy endpoints are independent accounts; committed block ranges are not rescanned; finalized head is required with no latest fallback
FR-6: Imported history stays legacy until ONCHAIN_START_DATE; from that date the new collector covers whole days; V1 Exchange history is not auto-recovered via RPC
FR-7: esports-trader reads published files and on-chain manifests; Python on-chain collection is deleted after local+VPS verification
Resolved Questions: Step count: five. Two cannot fit one implementer context window. Four would glue RPC and day publication together. Five is catalog/decode, RPC, publish, service+import+live Alchemy, then VPS+trader cutover.
V1 includes VPS bootstrap, import, and enabling compose `onchain`, not only local code.

Python on-chain collection is deleted in the last step after TypeScript verification. No overlapping dual-collector period. Rollback keeps archives and imported files; it does not keep a second downloader.

yarn check stays offline: fake Effect Layers plus recorded JSON-RPC/Telonex fixtures copied from esports-trader. Agent, not the user, runs one live Alchemy catch-up of a completed UTC day locally into a separate directory as US-004 acceptance. Keys already exist as two separate Alchemy accounts; endpoint URLs never appear in logs or manifests.
ONCHAIN_START_DATE is a required env with no default. The concrete date is written by the US-004/US-005 bootstrap report, not hardcoded in source.
Separate process entry (`src/onchain-main.ts` / `node dist/onchain-main.js`) and a second import command on the same image. Do not extend collect/compact Settings with a fake tag id.
Own on-chain manifests. Compact Manifest schema keeps rejecting channel `onchain_fills`. Staging lives under each game archive `.onchain/`, not `parquet/**/*.tmp`.
Follow300 current-task was archived to docs/completed-tasks/follow300-shared-core/ before this file was written.
Non-Goals (Out of Scope for V1): Automatic RPC recovery of pre-current-Exchange (V1) history
Publishing the in-progress current UTC day
Rescanning all imported history before ONCHAIN_START_DATE
Extending the compactor manifest to accept onchain_fills
Copying compaction checkpoint/sweep/journal as on-chain state

steps.title: Catalog, ABI decode, and ONCHAIN_SCHEMA parquet
steps.description: As a developer, I need sidecar-driven token maps and Telonex-compatible decoded rows on disk so later RPC work has a stable write path.
changes: Add a catalog module that reads `metadata/markets/<condition_id>.json` from both archive roots and maps token → game/condition/outcome index/sibling; IDs stay strings; missing observation timestamps conservatively include the market

Decode OrderFilled and OrdersMatched for CTF Exchange `0xE111180000d2663C0091e4f400237545B87B996B` and Neg Risk `0xe2222d279d744050d28e00520010520000310F59`; emit own and mirrored sibling rows; drop the taker-aggregate fill against the actual exchange address; price is 6 decimal half-even; amount/fee are decimal strings; ABI integers are bigint

Write DuckDB Parquet with the 26 ONCHAIN_SCHEMA columns in Telonex order and physical types: INT64 `block_number`/`block_timestamp_us`, INT32 `transaction_index`/`log_index`/`chain_id`, UINT8 `outcome_id`, BOOLEAN `mirrored`, remaining STRING
Copy the needed recorded Telonex/RPC fixtures from esports-trader into collector tests; document any decode-field mismatch with Python before renaming fields to hide it

Tests cover conflicting pair/index (diagnostic, not complete), large token IDs not going through JS number, empty table with full schema, and sort order block_number/transaction_index/log_index/contract_address/mirrored

steps.title: RPC client, two endpoints, UTC block bounds
steps.description: As a collector, I need Polygon logs from two independent Alchemy accounts with typed errors and finalized UTC day bounds.
changes: JSON-RPC over Effect HttpClient for chain 137, both exchange addresses, topics OrderFilled and OrdersMatched; parse JSON-RPC error bodies on HTTP 400; typed errors for range-too-wide, rate-limit, quota, transport, invalid payload; no filterStatusOk that drops the range-too-wide message

Two Redacted endpoints, each with its own CU weights, concurrency ceiling, 429/Retry-After pause, and quota handling; a failed task may move to the other endpoint; a durably committed range is never reassigned

UTC day bounds are the first block with timestamp >= start and the first block with timestamp >= end, end exclusive; readiness requires `finalized` head; disagreeing chain id or control block hashes leave the day pending; no automatic latest fallback
Unsupported pre-current-Exchange ranges fail with an explicit unsupported-period error, not an empty ready file
Tests use fake Layers plus recorded JSON-RPC fixtures: 400/range split, 429, partial quota, lost/invalid payload, disagreeing endpoints, unfinalized head

steps.title: Planner, durable ledger, and day publication
steps.description: As a collector, I need crash-safe UTC-day publication for both games from a catalog snapshot, with own manifests.
changes: Planner lists unfinished days from required ONCHAIN_START_DATE using a catalog fingerprint snapshot; a new token after a scan marks that pair uncovered without invalidating other tokens' ready files; contradictory pairs get a diagnostic status and are not complete

Durable ledger stores committed whole-block chunks (bounds, addresses, decoder version, catalog fingerprint, control block hashes), including successful empty ranges; restart repeats only uncommitted work; out-of-order completion cannot advance a cursor through a hole

Stage under each game archive `.onchain/`, then atomic-rename into `parquet/onchain_fills/asset_id=<token>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.parquet`; empty files publish only after confirmed coverage for markets that could trade that day; each row's timestamp matches the filename UTC date

Publish a per-game/day on-chain manifest last (files, sizes, hashes, row counts, coverage, catalog/decoder versions, control blocks, provenance). Compact Manifest still rejects channel `onchain_fills`. A UTC day is complete only when both games are ready
Crash tests: kill before durable chunk, after chunk, and between the two game publishes; restart finishes the operation without gaps or duplicates and without deleting committed ledger rows
